summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), following the spec's seven-step procedure. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with one parametrized test over valid and invalid shapes plus a non-node test. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (41 passed). Lines are within 88 columns. mypy, ruff and black are not installed in the shared venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only. Nothing was committed.
